description: This file defines a Fragment subclass called LogFragment that manages a LogView within a ScrollView, displaying log data and ensuring the view scrolls to show the latest logs. It also sets up the view layout and text change listener.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that contains a LogView inside a ScrollView, used for displaying log messages and automatically scrolling to the bottom when new logs are added.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures a ScrollView containing a LogView, applies layout parameters, padding, and style, and returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout by calling inflateViews, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on text change, and returns the view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
